from environment import * from physical import * from gpio import * from time import * import math # Purpose: # This object checks the click position in the object, converts it to an angle and bends the flexible component to that angle. # It writes an analog value from 0 to 100, with 0 being no bend and 100 being full bend. A 90 degree angle is considered a full bend.
pressedHere = False
def main(): analogWrite(A0, 0) setComponentRotation("flexEnd", 0) setDeviceProperty(getName(), "angle", 0) while True: delay(1000)
# Purpose: # Update function. Put your controls in here. def mouseEvent(pressed, x, y, firstPress): global pressedHere if firstPress == True: pressedHere = True
if pressed == True and pressedHere == True: # Calculate the angle between the vectors, one vector made by the touch point and a static vector. # For these images 120, 120 is the join point of the two. v1x = 1 v1y = 0 v2x = x - 120 v2y = y - 120
angle = angleAs360(v1x, v1y, v2x, v2y)
newAngle = findAngle(v1x, v1y, v2x, v2y) bend = abs(newAngle) percent = float(bend) / 90 if percent > 1: percent = 1
result = percent * 100 analogWrite(A0, result)
setComponentRotation("flexEnd", angle) setDeviceProperty(getName(), "angle", angle)
else: pressedHere = False analogWrite(A0, 0) setComponentRotation("flexEnd", 0) setDeviceProperty(getName(), "angle", 0)
# Purpose: # Takes two vectors and finds the angle between them. Value is in degrees [-180, 180]. def findAngle(cx, cy, ex, ey):
dy = ey - cy dx = ex - cx theta = math.atan2(dy, dx) temp = float(180) / math.pi theta = theta * temp return theta
# Purpose: # Takes two vectors and finds the angle between them. Value is in degrees [0, 360]. def angleAs360(cx, cy, ex, ey): theta = findAngle(cx, cy, ex, ey) if float(theta) < 0: theta = 360 + theta return theta
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

THING_MODEL.SPECIFICATIONS:
Flex Sensor
A sensor that detects the angle at which it was bent.

Features:
  • Output is in a range [0,100].
  • 0 === No bend
  • 100 === 90 degree or more bend
Usage:
  • Use ALT-Click to activate.
  • While holding on to ALT, drag mouse up and down to bend the sensor.
Direct Control:
  • ALT-Click and drag to bend
Local Control:
  • N/A
Remote Control:
  • N/A
Data Specifications:
  • Output Slot: A0
Example:
  • Connect Flex Sensor to an LED. Change the LED to use the sensor value and convert value to [0,256] in the light.
  • Alt-Click the sensor to bend it and watch the light get brighter the more the sensor is bent.
